verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product or platform that holds user data, so self-serve export of all data in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. Its GDPR practice and mention of internal legaltech tools describe advisory work or internal tooling, not a client-facing data store with export. The 404 probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI confirm there is no exposed data interface.
